$comment: The first time this repository crossed an OUTSIDE tool's raw output against its own answer key by file and line. Everything needed to repeat it is here: the tool, the commit it was pinned at, the command, the roots it was pointed at, and what was NOT exercised. No absolute path of the machine that ran it appears in this directory - the scan roots are recorded repo-relative, and the tool's own manifest.json, which embeds the absolute repo path it was handed, is deliberately NOT kept.

runner.$comment: Recorded because a number that only reproduces on one machine is not a number. Nothing was installed to get it: the tool ships a pre-built zero-dependency bundle at scripts/ultrasec.mjs and runs under plain node.

install.$comment: git clone + git checkout <pinned_commit>, then `node scripts/ultrasec.mjs`. No npm install, no pip install, no global binary. This project installs nothing in order to measure: a number that needed an install on one laptop is a number nobody can reproduce.
install.network_used: On a cold machine the first scan downloads tree-sitter grammars into a shared user cache (~/.cache/codeindex). That is the tool's own behaviour, it happens once, and it is recorded here rather than left to surprise somebody repeating this offline.

$comment_raw_sha256: So that a corrupted or edited raw file is caught even when the edit does not move a score. The counts in scorecard.json answer whether the numbers still reproduce; these answer whether the bytes are still the ones the tool emitted.

default.$note: run once per case: <scan-root> is bench/cases/<case> in THIS repository and <run-dir> a scratch directory outside it. Only <run-dir>/findings.json is kept, under raw/default/<case>.findings.json.

recall.$note: run once per case: <scan-root> is bench/cases/<case> in THIS repository and <run-dir> a scratch directory outside it. Only <run-dir>/findings.json is kept, under raw/recall/<case>.findings.json.

artifacts_kept.raw/<arm>/<case>.findings.json: the tool's findings.json, byte for byte as it emitted it
not_kept: manifest.json (embeds the absolute scan path of the runner)
graph.json, DOSSIER.md, JOURNAL.md, cache/ (intermediates, not findings)

what_was_NOT_exercised: Its orchestration of third-party scanners. semgrep, bandit, gitleaks, trufflehog, osv-scanner and trivy are all absent on the runner, so --tools none was passed to make the run deterministic rather than a function of what happens to be installed.

Its adversarial AI verification stage, which is what turns its candidates into an adjudicated report. It needs a model and this project spends no model budget on a rival's pipeline. The numbers here are therefore its DETERMINISTIC ENGINE's, pre-verification - which cuts both ways: some candidates its verifier would discard are counted here as decoys reported.
